sources.title: Muse Glimmer | Meta
sources.snippet: An open 30B model for always-on local agents. Runs on a single GPU, Apache 2.0 licensed. Tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.

sources.snippet: meta / muse-glimmer-30b Muse Glimmer Description Muse Glimmer is an approximately 29.6B-parameter dense multimodal causal language model with a dedicated perception encoder, distilled from Muse Spark and purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware.
